title: Pure Chaos
logline: A system overloads at full extreme from the first breath, blacks out twice without warning, crawls back each time, then climbs unstoppably into a total blackout.
mood_arc: maximum chaos from the first bar
energy_shape: slammed to extreme at bar one, no build-in; two sudden cliff-edge drops to near silence, each followed by a slow trickling rebuild back to chaos; final scene is an ever-building climb with no ceiling, ending in a total wall-of-notes blackout
tempo_feel: relentless, ~160 bpm, accelerating further into the finale
must_have_moments: full extreme intensity from the very first bar, no gentle intro
two sudden silent drops that catch the listener off guard
a trickle of notes crawling back after each drop
a final climb that never plateaus, ending in a total blackout wall of notes
notes: Two full drop-and-rebuild cycles before the final unstoppable climax. Register and density should max out at the very end.
